title: Investigating Fairness Disparities in Peer Review: A Language Model Enhanced Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in peer review acceptance rates and predictive model fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, AUC Difference) based on the authors' geographical locations, which are inferred from their email domain names.
Evaluating disparities in peer review acceptance rates and predictive model fairness metrics based on authors' self-reported gender or perceived gender inferred from first names.
Evaluating disparities in peer review acceptance rates and predictive model fairness metrics based on the academic prestige of the authors, measured by citation counts and institutional rankings.
